pages.title: Phantom Sword
pages.text: Bound with the souls of phantoms, this ghostly blade deals 10 attack damage with an attack speed of 1.8 and endures 2512 uses. But its story does not end here: the Phantom Sword is also the base for the mighty Unorithe Sword.

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: A Phantom Ingot on top and one in the middle, flanked by two Phantom Souls, with a stick below.
